session_summary: Verified a reported "step output not rendering" bug, fixed it, and released v0.1.2. code-analyst traced the path and found the root cause: src/parsers/logs.js had a charCodeAt(0)!==91 fast-path that dropped every stream-JSON ({-starting) log line, so [STEP N]/[DONE] markers embedded in JSON text were never parsed — the prior v0.1.1 fix (2ad42ab) only fixed offset-seeding, and its green test used a synthetic plain-text fixture that masked the bug. fullstack-dev fixed the parser to mine markers from both plain-text and stream-JSON, added a real stream-JSON fixture + regression test (proven to fail pre-fix); 139/139 tests pass. Committed (baa3dd4), bumped to 0.1.2, release-committed (f043068), pushed branch + tag v0.1.2 to origin. bd stats: 83 total, 83 closed, 0 open/blocked.

agent_feedback.needs_improvement: On the first fix-commit dispatch, committer hit its 10-turn max_turns DURING post-commit validation (it spent turns force-adding a gitignored *.log fixture and hit a 'could not write config file .gitconfig: Device or resource busy' warning), so it exited code=1 even though the commit had already landed correctly. This produced a false-failure that required the orchestrator to manually verify git state.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Have committer (1) do all post-commit validation in a SINGLE combined command to conserve turns, and (2) treat a non-zero exit AFTER a confirmed successful 'git commit' as success — i.e. verify HEAD before declaring failure. Also document the .gitconfig 'Device or resource busy' warning as benign in the container.

agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Worked well — correctly used a real production log as the fixture source and proved the test fails pre-fix.

overall_notes: Key lesson reinforced: a green test suite that uses a fabricated fixture in a format the real system never emits is worse than no test — it actively masks a production bug. The redesign value here was code-analyst verifying field-name matches across the full path (parse->state->transport->frontend) and isolating the break to the very first hop. Tooling note: committer's max_turns false-failure (above) cost an extra verification round; the gitignored-fixture force-add is a recurring friction point. No Alexandria guide updates this session (no new tool setup).
